## Overview

This step:

1. pulls GTEx tissue + TCGA project from **recount3**
2. normalizes to **logCPM**
3. collapses to **gene symbols** (protein-coding only; mean across duplicate symbols)
4. runs **Hallmark ssGSEA** once on the combined matrix (GTEx + NAT + PT), then splits back
5. saves clean objects for downstream scripts (clock training + delta-age analyses)

## Helper functions

```{r}
reactable_pretty <- function(df) {
  if (!requireNamespace("reactable", quietly = TRUE)) return(df)
  reactable::reactable(df, searchable = TRUE, resizable = TRUE)
}

# Collapse recount3 RSE rows → SYMBOL-level matrix (mean across duplicates)
sym_from_rse <- function(rse, protein_coding_only = TRUE, drop_par_y = TRUE, verbose = TRUE) {
  stopifnot("logCPM" %in% assayNames(rse))
  rd  <- as.data.frame(rowData(rse))
  mat <- assay(rse, "logCPM")

  keep <- !is.na(rd$gene_name) & rd$gene_name != ""

  if (protein_coding_only) {
    if (!"gene_type" %in% names(rd)) stop("rowData(rse)$gene_type missing; cannot filter to protein_coding.")
    keep <- keep & rd$gene_type == "protein_coding"
  }

  if (drop_par_y && "gene_id" %in% names(rd)) {
    keep <- keep & !grepl("_PAR_Y$", rd$gene_id)
  }

  mat_keep <- mat[keep, , drop = FALSE]
  syms     <- rd$gene_name[keep]

  mat_sum   <- rowsum(mat_keep, syms)
  dup_count <- table(syms)[rownames(mat_sum)]
  out       <- mat_sum / as.numeric(dup_count)

  if (isTRUE(verbose)) {
    message("sym_from_rse: kept rows=", sum(keep),
            " | unique SYMBOLs=", nrow(out),
            " | protein_coding_only=", protein_coding_only,
            " | drop_par_y=", drop_par_y)
  }

  out
}

# Hallmark gene sets with readable names (50 pathways)
get_hallmark_sets <- function() {
  hall_raw <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H")

  nice <- function(x) {
    x %>%
      str_remove("^HALLMARK_") %>%
      str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
      str_to_title()
  }

  split(hall_raw$gene_symbol, nice(hall_raw$gs_name))
}

# ssGSEA wrapper (GSVA >= 1.50 uses Param objects)
run_ssgsea <- function(expr_mat, gene_sets) {
  param <- ssgseaParam(
    exprData  = expr_mat,   # genes × samples
    geneSets  = gene_sets,
    minSize   = 1,
    maxSize   = Inf,
    alpha     = 0.25,
    normalize = FALSE       # avoid dataset-dependent scaling
  )
  gsva(param, verbose = FALSE)
}
```

## Load GTEx tissue + TCGA project from recount3
```{r}
analysis_id <- paste0(params$tcga_project, "__", params$gtex_project)

out_root_abs <- here::here(params$out_root)
proc_dir     <- file.path(out_root_abs, analysis_id)

dir.create(proc_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

msg <- function(...) if (isTRUE(params$verbose)) message(...)
suffix <- paste0("-", params$feature_set)

msg("out_root (abs) = ", out_root_abs)
msg("proc_dir      = ", proc_dir)
```

```{r}
set.seed(params$seed)

human_projects <- available_projects()

# GTEx tissue
gtex_info <- human_projects %>%
  dplyr::filter(project_type == "data_sources", project == params$gtex_project)

if (nrow(gtex_info) == 0) {
  stop("Could not find GTEx project '", params$gtex_project, "' in recount3::available_projects().")
}

# TCGA cancer
tcga_info <- human_projects %>%
  dplyr::filter(project_type == "data_sources", project == params$tcga_project)

if (nrow(tcga_info) == 0) {
  stop("Could not find TCGA project '", params$tcga_project, "' in recount3::available_projects().")
}

msg("Creating RSEs (this may download data on first run)...")
rse_gene_gtex <- create_rse(gtex_info)
rse_gene_tcga <- create_rse(tcga_info)
```


### Drop HPV+ samples (HNSC only)
```{r}
# ---- HNSC only: drop HPV+ using harmonized_metadata.rds ----
if (identical(params$tcga_project, "HNSC")) {

  if (is.null(params$harmonized_metadata_rds) || !file.exists(params$harmonized_metadata_rds)) {
    stop("HNSC HPV filtering requested but harmonized_metadata_rds not found: ", params$harmonized_metadata_rds)
  }

  cd <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_gene_tcga))
  if (!"tcga.tcga_barcode" %in% colnames(cd)) {
    stop("tcga.tcga_barcode missing from recount3 colData; cannot apply HPV filter for HNSC.")
  }

  meta_full <- readRDS(params$harmonized_metadata_rds)
  req <- c("project", "submitter_id", "HPV.status")
  if (!all(req %in% colnames(meta_full))) {
    stop("harmonized_metadata.rds missing required columns: ", paste(setdiff(req, colnames(meta_full)), collapse = ", "))
  }

  meta_hnsc <- meta_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(project == "TCGA-HNSC") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(patient12 = substr(submitter_id, 1, 12)) %>%
    dplyr::select(patient12, HPV.status)

  hpv_map <- setNames(as.character(meta_hnsc$HPV.status), meta_hnsc$patient12)

  patient12 <- substr(cd$tcga.tcga_barcode, 1, 12)
  hpv <- toupper(trimws(as.character(hpv_map[patient12])))

  # keep everything except HPV+ (unknown/NA are kept)
  keep <- !(hpv %in% c("POSITIVE", "HPV+", "HPV POSITIVE"))

  cat("HNSC HPV filter: dropping ", sum(!keep, na.rm = TRUE),
      " HPV+ samples; keeping ", sum(keep, na.rm = TRUE), "/", length(keep))

  rse_gene_tcga <- rse_gene_tcga[, keep]
}
```

## Normalize counts → logCPM

```{r}
assay(rse_gene_gtex, "counts") <- transform_counts(rse_gene_gtex)
assay(rse_gene_tcga, "counts") <- transform_counts(rse_gene_tcga)

dge_gtex <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = assay(rse_gene_gtex, "counts"))
dge_gtex <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge_gtex, method = "TMM")
assay(rse_gene_gtex, "logCPM") <-
  edgeR::cpm(dge_gtex, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

dge_tcga <- edgeR::DGEList(counts = assay(rse_gene_tcga, "counts"))
dge_tcga <- edgeR::calcNormFactors(dge_tcga, method = "TMM")
assay(rse_gene_tcga, "logCPM") <-
  edgeR::cpm(dge_tcga, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

```

## Add ages

### GTEx ages (protected file)

```{r}
# ---- GTEx ages (protected, numeric; v10) ----
if (!is.null(params$gtex_age_tsv) && file.exists(params$gtex_age_tsv)) {

  age_specific <- read.delim(
    params$gtex_age_tsv,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  if (!all(c("SUBJID", "AGE") %in% colnames(age_specific))) {
    stop("GTEx age file must contain SUBJID and AGE columns.")
  }

  age_years <- age_specific$AGE[
    match(colData(rse_gene_gtex)$gtex.subjid, age_specific$SUBJID)
  ]

  colData(rse_gene_gtex)$age_years <- as.numeric(age_years)

  msg(
    "Attached GTEx ages: non-missing = ",
    sum(!is.na(colData(rse_gene_gtex)$age_years)),
    "/",
    ncol(rse_gene_gtex)
  )

} else {
  stop("GTEx age file not found; cannot train GTEx clock.")
}

```

### TCGA ages (from recount3 colData)

```{r}
cd_tcga <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_gene_tcga))
if ("tcga.cgc_case_age_at_diagnosis" %in% colnames(cd_tcga)) {
  colData(rse_gene_tcga)$age_years <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(cd_tcga$tcga.cgc_case_age_at_diagnosis))
  msg("Attached TCGA ages: non-missing = ", sum(!is.na(colData(rse_gene_tcga)$age_years)),
      "/", ncol(rse_gene_tcga))
} else {
  warning("tcga.cgc_case_age_at_diagnosis not found; TCGA ages will be NA.")
  colData(rse_gene_tcga)$age_years <- NA_real_
}
```

## Optional GTEx sex filter

```{r}
if (!is.null(params$gtex_sex_keep)) {
  sex_keep <- unlist(params$gtex_sex_keep)
  cd <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_gene_gtex))
  if (!"gtex.sex" %in% colnames(cd)) {
    warning("gtex.sex not found; cannot apply sex filter.")
  } else {
    keep <- cd$gtex.sex %in% sex_keep
    msg("Applying GTEx sex filter: keeping ", sum(keep), "/", length(keep), " samples.")
    rse_gene_gtex <- rse_gene_gtex[, keep]
  }
}
```

## Split TCGA into NAT and primary tumor

```{r}
cd_tcga <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_gene_tcga))

# recount3 TCGA sample type column (known-good)
if (!"tcga.cgc_sample_sample_type" %in% colnames(cd_tcga)) {
  stop("tcga.cgc_sample_sample_type missing from TCGA colData; cannot split PT vs NAT.")
}

samptype <- cd_tcga$tcga.cgc_sample_sample_type

tum_types <- unlist(params$tcga_tumor_types)
nat_types <- unlist(params$tcga_normal_types)

tum_keep <- samptype %in% tum_types
nat_keep <- samptype %in% nat_types

rse_pt_tcga <- rse_gene_gtex[, FALSE]  # placeholder to keep structure
rse_nt_tcga <- rse_gene_gtex[, FALSE]

rse_pt_tcga <- rse_gene_tcga[, tum_keep]
rse_nt_tcga <- rse_gene_tcga[, nat_keep]

msg("TCGA split: PT n=", ncol(rse_pt_tcga), " | NAT n=", ncol(rse_nt_tcga))
msg("NAT sufficient? (min_nat=", params$min_nat, ") -> ", ncol(rse_nt_tcga) >= params$min_nat)

```

## Optional annotations

### Subtype (e.g., BRCA PAM50) from harmonized_metadata.rds

```{r}
# Default: fill with NA (only if there are samples)
if (ncol(rse_pt_tcga) > 0) {
  colData(rse_pt_tcga)[[params$subtype_label]] <- rep(NA_character_, ncol(rse_pt_tcga))
}
if (ncol(rse_nt_tcga) > 0) {
  colData(rse_nt_tcga)[[params$subtype_label]] <- rep(NA_character_, ncol(rse_nt_tcga))
}

if (!is.null(params$harmonized_metadata_rds) &&
    file.exists(params$harmonized_metadata_rds) &&
    !is.null(params$subtype_field)) {

  meta_full <- readRDS(params$harmonized_metadata_rds)
  tcga_proj_full <- paste0("TCGA-", params$tcga_project)

  if ("project" %in% colnames(meta_full) && "submitter_id" %in% colnames(meta_full) &&
      params$subtype_field %in% colnames(meta_full)) {

    meta_tcga <- meta_full %>%
      dplyr::filter(project == tcga_proj_full) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(patient12 = substr(submitter_id, 1, 12))

    # map by patient barcode (12 chars) from recount3 colData
    map_subtype <- setNames(meta_tcga[[params$subtype_field]], meta_tcga$patient12)

    # clean labels like "BRCA.LumA" → "LumA" (generic: drop leading "XXXX.")
    clean_subtype <- function(x) {
      x <- as.character(x)
      x <- sub(paste0("^", params$tcga_project, "\\."), "", x)
      x <- sub("^.+\\.", "", x)
      x
    }

    get_patient12 <- function(rse) {
      cd <- as.data.frame(colData(rse))
      if ("tcga.tcga_barcode" %in% colnames(cd)) substr(cd$tcga.tcga_barcode, 1, 12) else NA_character_
    }

    pt_pat <- get_patient12(rse_pt_tcga)
    nt_pat <- get_patient12(rse_nt_tcga)

    colData(rse_pt_tcga)[[params$subtype_label]] <- clean_subtype(map_subtype[pt_pat])
    colData(rse_nt_tcga)[[params$subtype_label]] <- clean_subtype(map_subtype[nt_pat])

    msg("Subtype attach: PT non-NA=", sum(!is.na(colData(rse_pt_tcga)[[params$subtype_label]])),
        " | NAT non-NA=", sum(!is.na(colData(rse_nt_tcga)[[params$subtype_label]])))
  } else {
    warning("harmonized_metadata.rds missing required columns; skipping subtype attach.")
  }
} else {
  msg("Subtype attach skipped (file not found or params unset).")
}
```

### TP53 mutation (optional)

```{r}
# Default: NA
if (ncol(rse_pt_tcga) > 0) colData(rse_pt_tcga)$TP53 <- rep(NA_character_, ncol(rse_pt_tcga))
if (ncol(rse_nt_tcga) > 0) colData(rse_nt_tcga)$TP53 <- rep(NA_character_, ncol(rse_nt_tcga))

if (!is.null(params$tp53_cbioportal_tsv) && file.exists(params$tp53_cbioportal_tsv)) {
  tp53_tab <- read.delim(params$tp53_cbioportal_tsv)

  req_cols <- c("Sample.ID", "Mutation.Type")
  if (!all(req_cols %in% colnames(tp53_tab))) {
    warning("TP53 cBioPortal TSV missing required columns (need: Sample.ID, Mutation.Type); skipping TP53 status attach.")
  } else {

    # Define "Mut" consistently (as in the known-good version)
    keep_mt <- tp53_tab$Mutation.Type %in% c(
      "Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation",
      "Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins",
      "Splice_Site", "Splice_Region",
      "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins"
    )

    mut_bar <- substr(tp53_tab$Sample.ID[keep_mt], 1, 12)
    mut_bar <- unique(mut_bar[!is.na(mut_bar)])

    # Map TCGA UUID colnames -> barcode12 (from colData), then invert to barcode12 -> UUID
    cd_pt <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_pt_tcga))
    if (!"tcga.tcga_barcode" %in% colnames(cd_pt)) {
      warning("tcga.tcga_barcode missing from rse_pt_tcga colData; cannot map TP53 calls; skipping.")
    } else {
      uuid2bar <- setNames(substr(cd_pt$tcga.tcga_barcode, 1, 12), colnames(rse_pt_tcga))
      uuid2bar <- uuid2bar[!is.na(uuid2bar) & uuid2bar != ""]

      bar2uuid <- setNames(names(uuid2bar), uuid2bar)

      uuid_mut <- bar2uuid[mut_bar]
      uuid_mut <- unique(uuid_mut[!is.na(uuid_mut)])

      tp53_status <- function(uids, mut_uids) {
        v <- rep("WT", length(uids)); names(v) <- uids
        v[uids %in% mut_uids] <- "Mut"
        v
      }

      # Attach to PT and NAT by UUID (NAT typically WT, but this keeps the behavior consistent)
      colData(rse_pt_tcga)$TP53 <- tp53_status(colnames(rse_pt_tcga), uuid_mut)
      colData(rse_nt_tcga)$TP53 <- tp53_status(colnames(rse_nt_tcga), uuid_mut)

      msg("TP53 attach: PT Mut=", sum(colData(rse_pt_tcga)$TP53 == "Mut", na.rm = TRUE),
          " | NAT Mut=", sum(colData(rse_nt_tcga)$TP53 == "Mut", na.rm = TRUE))
    }
  }
} else {
  msg("TP53 attach skipped (file not found).")
}

```

## Build symbol-level logCPM matrices (protein-coding) and harmonize gene universe

```{r}
logcpm_gtex_sym <- sym_from_rse(rse_gene_gtex, protein_coding_only = TRUE, drop_par_y = TRUE, verbose = params$verbose)
logcpm_pt_sym   <- sym_from_rse(rse_pt_tcga,   protein_coding_only = TRUE, drop_par_y = TRUE, verbose = params$verbose)
logcpm_nt_sym   <- sym_from_rse(rse_nt_tcga,   protein_coding_only = TRUE, drop_par_y = TRUE, verbose = params$verbose)

universe_pc <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  rownames(logcpm_gtex_sym),
  rownames(logcpm_pt_sym),
  rownames(logcpm_nt_sym)
))
if (length(universe_pc) == 0) stop("No shared gene universe across GTEx/PT/NAT.")

logcpm_gtex_sym <- logcpm_gtex_sym[universe_pc, , drop = FALSE]
logcpm_pt_sym   <- logcpm_pt_sym  [universe_pc, , drop = FALSE]
logcpm_nt_sym   <- logcpm_nt_sym  [universe_pc, , drop = FALSE]

stopifnot(identical(rownames(logcpm_gtex_sym), rownames(logcpm_pt_sym)))
stopifnot(identical(rownames(logcpm_gtex_sym), rownames(logcpm_nt_sym)))

msg("Gene universe (protein-coding SYMBOLs): ", length(universe_pc))
```

## Hallmark ssGSEA (run once on combined matrix)

```{r}
hall_sets <- get_hallmark_sets()

expr_all <- cbind(logcpm_gtex_sym, logcpm_nt_sym, logcpm_pt_sym)

scores_all <- run_ssgsea(expr_all, hall_sets)

n_gtex <- ncol(logcpm_gtex_sym)
n_nt   <- ncol(logcpm_nt_sym)

# GTEx always exists
scores_gtex <- scores_all[, seq_len(n_gtex), drop = FALSE]

# NAT: only if present
if (n_nt > 0) {
  scores_nt <- scores_all[, seq.int(n_gtex + 1, n_gtex + n_nt), drop = FALSE]
} else {
  scores_nt <- scores_all[, 0, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(scores_nt) <- colnames(logcpm_nt_sym)
}

# PT: whatever remains
scores_pt <- scores_all[, -(seq_len(n_gtex + n_nt)), drop = FALSE]


stopifnot(identical(colnames(scores_gtex), colnames(logcpm_gtex_sym)))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(scores_nt),   colnames(logcpm_nt_sym)))
stopifnot(identical(colnames(scores_pt),   colnames(logcpm_pt_sym)))

msg("ssGSEA dims: all=", paste(dim(scores_all), collapse="×"),
    " | gtex=", paste(dim(scores_gtex), collapse="×"),
    " | nat=", paste(dim(scores_nt), collapse="×"),
    " | pt=", paste(dim(scores_pt), collapse="×"))
```

## Minimal QC summary

```{r}
qc_tbl <- tibble(
  cohort = c("GTEx", "TCGA-AN", "TCGA-PT"),
  n      = c(ncol(scores_gtex), ncol(scores_nt), ncol(scores_pt)),
  age_nonmissing = c(
    sum(!is.na(colData(rse_gene_gtex)$age_years)),
    sum(!is.na(colData(rse_nt_tcga)$age_years)),
    sum(!is.na(colData(rse_pt_tcga)$age_years))
  )
)
reactable_pretty(qc_tbl)

# Optional: age distribution quick plot (skips cohorts with all-NA ages)
age_df <- bind_rows(
  tibble(cohort = "GTEx",   age = colData(rse_gene_gtex)$age_years),
  tibble(cohort = "TCGA-AN",age = colData(rse_nt_tcga)$age_years),
  tibble(cohort = "TCGA-PT",age = colData(rse_pt_tcga)$age_years)
) %>% filter(!is.na(age))

if (nrow(age_df) > 0) {
  ggplot(age_df, aes(x = age, fill = cohort)) +
    geom_histogram(bins = 30, alpha = 0.6, position = "identity") +
    facet_wrap(~ cohort, nrow = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(title = paste0("Age distributions: ", analysis_id),
         x = "Chronological age (years)", y = "Count")
}
```

## Build and save metadata

```{r}
meta_gtex <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_gene_gtex)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  mutate(cohort = "GTEx")

meta_nt <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_nt_tcga)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  mutate(cohort = "TCGA-AN")

meta_pt <- as.data.frame(colData(rse_pt_tcga)) %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column("sample_id") %>%
  mutate(cohort = "TCGA-PT")

metadata <- bind_rows(meta_gtex, meta_nt, meta_pt) %>%
  as.data.frame()

rownames(metadata) <- metadata$sample_id

# sanity: metadata rows align to score cols
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_gtex) %in% rownames(metadata)))
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_pt)   %in% rownames(metadata)))
stopifnot(all(colnames(scores_nt)   %in% rownames(metadata)))

# GTEx scalers for optional downstream z-scoring (uses GTEx only)
gtex_scalers <- data.frame(
  pathway = colnames(t(scores_gtex)),
  mu  = colMeans(t(scores_gtex), na.rm = TRUE),
  sd  = apply(t(scores_gtex), 2, sd, na.rm = TRUE),
  row.names = NULL
)
```

saveRDS(logcpm_gtex_sym, file = file.path(proc_dir, paste0("logcpm_gtex_sym", suffix, ".rds")))
saveRDS(logcpm_nt_sym,   file = file.path(proc_dir, paste0("logcpm_nt_sym",   suffix, ".rds")))
saveRDS(logcpm_pt_sym,   file = file.path(proc_dir, paste0("logcpm_pt_sym",   suffix, ".rds")))

msg("Saved outputs to: ", proc_dir)
